title: Lost in Moderation: How Commercial Content Moderation APIs Over- and Under-Moderate Group-Targeted Hate Speech and Linguistic Variations
reasoning: The paper evaluates and benchmarks the performance of content moderation APIs specifically across religious groups, including 'Jewish' and 'Muslim' categories. It analyzes algorithmic bias, over-moderation, and under-moderation targeting these faith-based identities using multiple datasets and explainability frameworks.
